name: Web Search Plus
description: One clean set of source-only web tools for Routing v2 multi-provider search, research mode, canonical-source reranking, spam/mirror filtering, unified freshness and news vertical, locale defaults, and Tavily-first extraction. Supports Serper/Google, Brave, Tavily, Exa, Querit, Linkup, Firecrawl, Parallel, SerpBase, You.com, SearXNG, Keenable, and a local Hound MCP sidecar.

serperApiKey.description: Serper API key for Google-style web search. Optional individually, but at least one provider setting in this plugin must be configured.

braveApiKey.description: Brave Search API key for general web, current, and shopping-style search. Optional individually, but at least one provider setting in this plugin must be configured.

tavilyApiKey.description: Tavily API key for research-oriented search. Optional individually, but at least one provider setting in this plugin must be configured.

linkupApiKey.description: Linkup API key for source-grounded search with citations, references, and evidence-focused queries. Optional individually, but at least one provider setting in this plugin must be configured.

queritApiKey.description: Querit API key for multilingual AI search. Optional individually, but at least one provider setting in this plugin must be configured.

exaApiKey.description: Exa API key for neural, deep, and deep-reasoning search. Optional individually, but at least one provider setting in this plugin must be configured.

firecrawlApiKey.description: Firecrawl API key for web search with optional page extraction metadata and Google-style recency/domain filtering. Optional individually, but at least one provider setting in this plugin must be configured.

youApiKey.description: You.com API key for general web and answer-oriented search. Optional individually, but at least one provider setting in this plugin must be configured.

searxngInstanceUrl.description: Base URL for a SearXNG instance. Optional individually, but at least one provider setting in this plugin must be configured.

searxngAllowPrivate.description: Optional danger flag. When true, disables SearXNG SSRF/private-network protection and should only be used on fully trusted private networks.

routingConfigPath.description: Optional namespace for in-memory routing preferences used by web_routing_config_plus. No filesystem reads are performed at runtime.

routingPreferences.description: Initial routing preferences, including profile=standard or profile=self_hosted. Runtime updates remain in the selected in-memory namespace.

parallelApiKey.description: Parallel API key for guarded search and extraction. Optional individually, but at least one provider setting in this plugin must be configured.

serpbaseApiKey.description: SerpBase API key for guarded Google-style alternate search. Optional individually, but at least one provider setting in this plugin must be configured.

keenableApiKey.description: Keenable API key for independent-index search and extraction. Optional individually, but at least one provider setting in this plugin must be configured.

keenableAllowPublic.description: Opt-in: allow Keenable's keyless public tier. Queries and fetched URLs are sent to an unauthenticated shared service (~1000 req/hour, no SLA). Off by default.

houndMcpUrl.description: Loopback-only Hound Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint, exactly http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp or http://[::1]:<port>/mcp.

houndTimeoutSeconds.description: Hound MCP call deadline in seconds (default 120, range 5-180).

houndMaxResponseBytes.description: Maximum bytes accepted from one Hound MCP response (default 2097152, hard maximum 16777216).

houndMaxContentChars.description: Maximum content characters requested from Hound smart_fetch per URL (default 40000, range 500-200000).

extractAllowPrivateUrls.description: Opt-in danger flag. When true, web_extract_plus may target private/internal URLs (trusted intranet extraction). Off by default.

extractCharLimit.description: Per-result inline character budget applied after aggregate prefix allocation and before head/tail truncation (default 15000, minimum 1000).

extractMaxUrls.description: Operator ceiling for URLs processed by one extraction call (default 10, hard maximum 50).

extractMaxContextChars.description: Operator ceiling for aggregate inline extraction prefixes in Unicode codepoints, applied before per-result head/tail truncation (default 60000, range 1000-200000).

extractCacheMaxEntries.description: Maximum process-local LRU entries for completed extraction requests (default 64, range 1-500). Entries are discarded when the host restarts.

extractCacheMaxChars.description: Maximum Unicode codepoints retained by the process-local extraction full-text LRU (default 4000000, range 1-20000000). Entries are discarded when the host restarts.

extractDeadlineSeconds.description: Operator ceiling for request-scoped extraction deadline in seconds (default 30, range 1-180). This is not a daily quota.

localeCountry.description: Default search country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. "at") for locale-capable providers (Serper, Brave, Querit, Firecrawl, You.com). Explicit location hints in the query still win. Without this the providers keep their us defaults.

localeLanguage.description: Default search language (ISO 639-1, e.g. "de") or "auto" for conservative query language inference. Without this the providers keep their en defaults.

parallelMaxCharsPerResult.description: Parallel extraction full_content budget per result in characters (default 60000).

qualityBlockedDomains.description: Extra domains removed from search results in addition to the built-in spam/mirror blocklist (exact domain or true subdomain matches only).

qualityAllowedDomains.description: Domains rescued from the built-in and extra blocklists.

qualityDiversityRerank.description: Opt-in: in research mode, move URL/content near-duplicate candidates behind the diverse result head without dropping them.

searxngInstanceUrl.label: SearXNG Instance URL
searxngInstanceUrl.description: Self-hosted metasearch instance URL. Counts as a configured provider even without an API key.

searxngAllowPrivate.label: Allow private-network SearXNG (danger)
searxngAllowPrivate.description: Disables SearXNG SSRF/private-network protection. Only enable on fully trusted private networks.

routingConfigPath.label: Routing preferences namespace
routingConfigPath.description: Optional namespace for runtime routing behavior. Secrets remain in plugin config; behavior is kept in process memory to avoid runtime filesystem reads.

keenableAllowPublic.label: Allow Keenable keyless public tier
keenableAllowPublic.description: Sends queries and fetched URLs to Keenable's unauthenticated shared service. Off by default.

extractAllowPrivateUrls.label: Allow private-network extraction targets (danger)
extractAllowPrivateUrls.description: Disables the private/internal URL guard for web_extract_plus. Only enable on fully trusted private networks.

qualityDiversityRerank.label: Rerank research duplicates
qualityDiversityRerank.description: Moves near-duplicate research results behind the diverse head. Off by default.
